从 Lumajang 一侧正式入口聘请熟悉当天水况的向导，沿开放的阶梯、钢梯及溪: Hire a guide familiar with the day's water conditions from the formal entrance on the Lumajang side, descend along open stairs, steel ladders, and stream routes for about 30–60 minutes to reach the valley bottom area permitted by management.
从 Paltuding 沿约3公里正式登山路线抵达火山口边缘，仅在管理方明确开放: Proceed from Paltuding along the approximately 3 km formal climbing route to the crater rim, enter designated areas only when management clearly opens intra-crater routes and a professional guide confirms safety; descending into the crater independently is prohibited.
从 Piaynemo 主观景区乘当地小艇前往邻近星形泻湖，在许可开放情况下由向导: Take a local small boat from the Piaynemo main viewing area to the adjacent star-shaped lagoon, and climb the short-distance limestone scenic route led by a guide under permitted open conditions.
从 Station 1 向北沿开放海岸步道步行约15–25分钟，若海岸通道因潮位: Walk north from Station 1 along the open coastal trail for about 15–25 minutes; if the coastal path is closed due to tide levels or maintenance, switch to an electric tricycle to enter via land routes.
从 Station 2 搭电动三轮车北行约20–35分钟至 Yapak 公共海滩: Take an electric tricycle from Station 2 heading north for about 20–35 minutes to the Yapak public beach entrance.
从 Waisai 或丹皮尔海峡度假村预约快艇前往 Fam 群岛，视出发点约1.5: Book a speedboat from Waisai or Dampier Strait resorts to the Fam Islands, approximately 1.5–3 hours depending on the departure point; ascend the viewing platform from the designated pier along formal wooden stairs, a walk of about 15–25 minutes.
从Alexandra Road与Depot Road交汇区域的公共人行道寻找无遮: Find unobstructed distant views from the public pedestrian walkway at the intersection of Alexandra Road and Depot Road, use 35–85mm to emphasize the overlapping block relationships. Do not treat private courtyards or resident balconies as public shooting spots. Won the World Architecture Festival Building of the Year Award in 2015; OMA co-founder Rem Koolhaas is the 2000 Pritzker Architecture Prize laureate, and the project's lead architect is Ole Scheeren. Check: oma.com/projects/the-interlace; Coordinates: mapcarta.com/W172481800.
从Armenian Street沿Lebuh Pantai步行至Pengkala: Walk from Armenian Street along Lebuh Pantai to Pengkalan Weld, then walk south for about 5 minutes to enter the Chew Jetty public open area.
从Bangsal港或相邻吉利岛乘船至Gili Meno，由当地合规浮潜或潜水运营: Take a boat from Bangsal Port or adjacent Gili islands to Gili Meno, led by local compliant snorkeling or diving operators to the western reef slope.
从Bayfront站步行约10–15分钟至艺术科学博物馆北侧入口，或由Prome: Walk about 10–15 minutes from Bayfront Station to the north entrance of the ArtScience Museum, or proceed via the boardwalk from Promenade Station. All-day free public pedestrian bridge.
从Berastagi沿Merek方向公路行驶约1–1.5小时，转入Tonggin: Drive from Berastagi toward Merek for about 1–1.5 hours, turn into the branch road for the Tongging and Sipiso-piso scenic area, and walk from the parking lot to the open viewing area.
从Braga南端公共人行道寻找独立大厦转角立面，使用35mm或50mm镜头保留建: Find the independent building corner facade from the public pedestrian walkway at the southern end of Braga, use a 35mm or 50mm lens to preserve building proportions. Do not set up tripods in the vehicle lanes.
从Bugis站步行约8–12分钟，或从哈芝巷步行约3–5分钟进入Bussorah: Walk about 8–12 minutes from Bugis Station, or walk about 3–5 minutes from Haji Lane to enter Bussorah Street. External public streets are free, internal visits must observe religious venue opening hours and dress codes.
从Diamond Beach乘车约10–20分钟至Raja Lima或Rumah: Drive from Diamond Beach for about 10–20 minutes to the Raja Lima or Rumah Pohon viewing area, and walk in according to on-site regulations.
从HarbourFront站经Marang Trail登花柏山，沿南部山脊步道前: Ascend Mount Faber from HarbourFront Station via the Marang Trail, proceed along the Southern Ridges trail to Henderson Waves, about 35–50 minutes, including continuous uphill sections. Can also take a vehicle to Mount Faber or Telok Blangah Hill Park to shorten the hiking distance.
从KL Sentral乘KLIA Transit至Putrajaya & Cyb: Take the KLIA Transit from KL Sentral to Putrajaya & Cyberjaya Station, then take a ride-hailing car for about 10–15 minutes to Putra Square; Putrajaya Lake sightseeing cruises can also be booked.
从KL Sentral乘KTM Komuter至Batu Caves终点站，下车: Take the KTM Komuter from KL Sentral to Batu Caves terminal station, walk about 5–10 minutes after getting off to reach the square, then enter the main cave along 272 stone steps.
从KLCC站沿Jalan Yap Kwan Seng方向步行约10分钟；预订具有: Walk about 10 minutes from KLCC Station along the direction of Jalan Yap Kwan Seng; book accommodation with access to the corresponding building's rooftop pool, and confirm accessible floors with the operator prior to check-in.
从KOMTAR乘Rapid Penang 204路巴士至升旗山缆车下站，购买往返: Take the Rapid Penang Bus 204 from KOMTAR to the lower station of Penang Hill funicular railway, purchase round-trip funicular tickets to go up the mountain; fast-track lanes can be considered during holidays.
从KOMTAR巴士总站进入The TOP综合体，购买高层观景项目门票后乘专用电梯: Enter The TOP complex from KOMTAR bus terminal, purchase tickets for high-rise viewing programs and take the dedicated elevator upstairs.
从Kelingking包车约20–35分钟，在Broken Beach共用停车区: Charter a car from Kulingking for about 20–35 minutes, get off at the Broken Beach shared parking area, and walk about 5–10 minutes.
从Kuta Lombok沿东南海岸及Jerowaru方向公路包车约2–3小时，最: Charter a car from Kuta Lombok along the southeast coast and Jerowaru direction highway for about 2–3 hours, finally arriving at Tangsi Beach via local branch roads.
从Pangururan向萨莫西尔岛中央高地行驶约30–60分钟，沿村道抵达Sid: Drive from Pangururan toward the central highlands of Samosir Island for about 30–60 minutes, and arrive at Lake Sidihoni along village roads.
从Pangururan沿Harian方向公路前往Hariara Pohan，约4: Drive from Pangururan along the Harian direction road to Hariara Pohan, about 45–75 minutes; walk up the grassy slope trail from the entrance for about 15–40 minutes.
从Pangururan沿Tele山地公路上行约45–75分钟，抵达Menara: Drive up the Tele mountain highway from Pangururan for about 45–75 minutes to reach Menara Pandang Tele viewing area.
从Pangururan经Harian沿Sibea-bea景区公路前往，车程约45: Proceed from Pangururan via Harian along the Sibea-bea scenic highway, the drive takes about 45–75 minutes.
从Pantai Cenang乘车约25–35分钟至Oriental Villag: Drive from Pantai Cenang for about 25–35 minutes to Oriental Village, purchase SkyCab cable car tickets to reach the top station, then purchase SkyBridge tickets, and access the bridge deck via open mountain trails or SkyGlide.
从Sembalun Lawang登山口经Pos 1、Pos 2及Pos 3，沿高: Climb from Sembalun Lawang trailhead via Pos 1, Pos 2, and Pos 3, ascending alpine grassy slopes to the designated crater campsite.
从Sembalun正式登山口出发，在注册向导带领下徒步约6–8小时至火山口营地，: Depart from the Sembalun formal trailhead, hike about 6–8 hours to the crater campsite under the guidance of a registered guide, and climb another 3–5 hours in the early hours of the next day to reach the summit.
从Senaru国家公园登山口经森林及高山草坡持续爬升，全天约7–9小时抵达火山口: Ascend continuously from the Senaru National Park trailhead through forests and alpine grassy slopes, taking about 7–9 hours all day to reach the crater campsite.
从Senaru村瀑布步道入口下行，经Sendang Gile方向进入森林步道，往: Descend from the Senaru village waterfall trail entrance, enter the forest trail via the Sendang Gile direction, round trip typically takes about 1.5–3 hours, wading conditions vary by season.
从Silangit机场沿Paranginan方向道路行驶约40–70分钟，再沿景: Drive from Silangit Airport along the Paranginan direction road for about 40–70 minutes, then enter the pine forest viewing area along the scenic trail.
从Tambolaka机场附近沿Kodi方向公路行驶约60–80分钟，再从景区停车: Drive from near Tambolaka Airport along the Kodi direction road for about 60–80 minutes, then walk from the scenic area parking lot to the lakeside wooden boardwalk.
从Tambolaka沿Kodi Bangedo方向公路驾车约60–90分钟，进入: Drive from Tambolaka along the Kodi Bangedo direction road for about 60–90 minutes, entering the traditional village of Maliti Bondo Ate.
从Tele或Harian沿当地支路前往Sosor Dolok瀑布停车区，随后步行: Proceed from Tele or Harian along local branch roads to the Sosor Dolok Waterfall parking area, followed by a walk of about 5–15 minutes.
从Toyapakeh港乘车约25–40分钟抵达海滩，潜水活动通过持证潜店安排船只: Drive from Toyapakeh Port for about 25–40 minutes to reach the beach, diving activities arrange boats and professional guides through certified dive shops.
从Toyapakeh港包车约45–60分钟，停车后步行至官方崖顶观景区，不将下崖: Charter a car from Toyapakeh Port for about 45–60 minutes, walk to the official cliff-top viewing area after parking, without making cliff descents a necessary itinerary item.
从Toyapakeh等港口随持证潜水机构乘船前往，船程受港口及海况影响，出航前由: Travel by boat from ports such as Toyapakeh with certified diving organizations, boat travel time is affected by port and sea conditions, and feasibility is judged by the dive guide before departure.
从Tuktuk住宿区沿萨莫西尔岛东岸公路驾车约15–30分钟至Ambarita传: Drive from Tuktuk accommodation area along the east coast highway of Samosir Island for about 15–30 minutes to Ambarita traditional village.
从Waikabubak向Wanokaka方向行驶约45–75分钟，进入Manup: Drive from Waikabubak toward Wanokaka for about 45–75 minutes, enter the Manupeu Tanah Daru conservation area and hike along formal trails for about 15–30 minutes.
从Waikabubak市区乘车约10–20分钟，进入Prai Ijing村落并前: Drive from downtown Waikabubak for about 10–20 minutes, enter the village of Prai Ijing and proceed to the open high-altitude viewing areas.
从Waingapu向北经Kanatang方向公路行驶约55–75分钟，进入Mon: Drive north from Waingapu via the Kanatang direction highway for about 55–75 minutes, entering the Puru Kambera grassland and coastal area near Mondu.
从Waingapu沿Trans-Sumba主公路向西行驶约45–55分钟，自观景: Drive west from Waingapu along the Trans-Sumba main highway for about 45–55 minutes, walk up the grassy slope from the viewing area entrance.
从Waingapu沿东向沿海公路驾车约25–40分钟，经Walakiri海滩入口: Drive from Waingapu along the east coastal highway for about 25–40 minutes, entering the mangrove intertidal zone via the Walakiri Beach entrance.
从Weekuri Lagoon沿当地支路驾车约5–10分钟，随后沿开放步道进入小: Drive from Weekuri Lagoon along local branch roads for about 5–10 minutes, then enter the small sandy cove along open trails.
从万隆市区包车向南约90–150分钟抵达Ciwidey景区，按照景区安排乘接驳车: Charter a car south from downtown Bandung for about 90–150 minutes to Ciwidey scenic area, take a shuttle bus or enter the upper parking lot as arranged by the scenic area, then walk to the open lakeshore.
从万隆火车站乘车约15–25分钟至Jalan Diponegoro，外部摄影与博: Drive from Bandung Railway Station for about 15–25 minutes to Jalan Diponegoro, exterior photography and museum visits follow on-site management regulations respectively.
从万隆火车站步行约20–25分钟，或乘网约车至Jalan Braga南端与Jal: Walk from Bandung Railway Station for about 20–25 minutes, or take a ride-hailing car to the intersection area of the southern end of Jalan Braga and Jalan Asia Afrika.
从乌布包车约90–120分钟抵达塔巴南县Jatiluwih，购买景区票后选择短程: Charter a car from Ubud for about 90–120 minutes to Jatiluwih, Tabanan Regency, purchase scenic area tickets and choose the short red walking route, entering the fields along irrigation canals.
从乌布王宫沿Jalan Monkey Forest步行约20–25分钟，购票后依: Walk from Ubud Palace along Jalan Monkey Forest for about 20–25 minutes, enter the outer periphery of Tirta Empul Temple and forest trails according to the park map after purchasing tickets.
从乔治市中心沿Lebuh Leith步行抵达，提前预订Blue Mansion官: Arrive on foot from the center of George Town along Lebuh Leith, pre-book the Blue Mansion official timed tour; lodging guests use corresponding spaces according to hotel rules.
从二奶巷进入Jalan Bijeh Timah周边历史街区，步行约3–5分钟抵达: Enter the historic district around Jalan Bijeh Timah from Concubine Lane, walk about 3–5 minutes to reach the road section where the related murals are located.
从伊斯蒂克拉尔清真寺步行至对面Gereja Katedral Jakarta，地: Walk from Istiqlal Mosque to Gereja Katedral Jakarta opposite, entering the underground friendship tunnel must comply with both parties' same-day opening and security check regulations.
从克里穆图停车场沿双湖方向正式步道前行，约15–25分钟抵达东侧观景区。: Proceed from the Kelimutu parking lot along the formal trail toward the twin lakes, arriving at the eastern viewing area in about 15–25 minutes.
从入口沿公共海滩步行寻找较少遮阳设施的自然海岸，使用低角度拍摄浪纹与沙粒。浪大时: Walk from the public beach from the entrance to find natural coasts with fewer shading facilities, use low angles to shoot wave patterns and sand grains. When waves are large, operate only at the shoreline, do not take away shells or coral.
从公共庭院朝架空建筑下方拍摄连续柱列，再到开放屋顶区域寻找水平海平线。不要将整个: Shoot continuous colonnades from the public courtyard looking beneath the elevated building, then find the horizontal sea level in open rooftop areas. Do not attribute the entire building complex to OMA designs. Architectural documentation: https://www.oma.com/projects/potato-head-studios
从公园总部选择当日开放的Telok Pandan Kecil徒步线路，单程通常需: Choose the Telok Pandan Kecil hiking route open on the day from the park headquarters, a one-way trip typically takes about 1.5–2 hours; returning by sea requires prior confirmation with the operating boatman.
从兰卡威机场或Pantai Cenang乘车约30–45分钟至Sungai Ki: Drive from Langkawi Airport or Pantai Cenang for about 30–45 minutes to Sungai Kilim Tourist Jetty, book a 2–4 hour mangrove boat tour with a licensed operator.
从兰卡威跨海转入近打谷: Cross from Langkawi into the Kinta Valley
从北侧公共道路或获准开放的前庭区域拍摄中央塔楼轴线。政府建筑并非全部向游客开放，: Photograph the central tower axis from the north public road or permitted open forecourt areas. Government buildings are not all open to visitors, museum reservations and visiting areas should be confirmed in advance.
从北部度假村或 Waigeo 一带预约具备远海航行能力的快艇，常需数小时单程，或: Book a speedboat capable of open-sea navigation from northern resorts or the Waigeo area, often requiring several hours one-way, or take a multi-day liveaboard; confirm local community permissions, landing routes, and viewing hill opening conditions in advance.
从南端进入后在第一个明显起伏的山脊处回望，以中焦镜头拍摄道路与行人比例。步道基本: Look back at the first obvious undulating ridge after entering from the southern end, using a medium telephoto lens to capture the scale proportion between the road and pedestrians. The trail is basically unshaded, avoid midday and thunderstorm weather.
从古晋或美里乘可用航班抵姆鲁机场，入住公园附近后报名Deer and Lang: Take an available flight from Kuching or Miri to Mulu Airport, sign up for the Deer and Lang Caves guided tour after checking in near the park, and walk from the park headquarters along about 3 km of boardwalks to the caves.
从国家公园停车场进入正式游览步道，沿青年湖观景台方向步行约20–30分钟。: Enter the formal tour trail from the National Park parking lot, walk along the direction of Youth Lake viewing platform for about 20–30 minutes.
从圣母岩礁以北公共海滩寻找空旷低机位，避免在潮水上涨时把设备直接放在沙地。该坐标: Find an open low camera angle from the public beach north of the Virgin Mary Reef, avoid placing equipment directly on sandy ground when the tide is rising. This coordinate is a reference location for the northern beach, not an actually measured photography station.
从塔比拉兰包车约30分钟，前往 Philippine Tarsier Found: Charter a car from Tagbilaran for about 30 minutes, head to the Corella Sanctuary managed by the Philippine Tarsier Foundation, and enter the forest trail guided by staff after purchasing tickets.
从塔比拉兰沿东部海岸公路乘车约15–25分钟，抵达教堂与历史博物馆区域。: Drive from Tagbilaran along the east coast highway for about 15–25 minutes to arrive at the church and historical museum area.
从外南梦 Banyuwangi 市区乘预约专车约60–100分钟抵达 Paltu: Take a reserved private car from downtown Banyuwangi to Paltuding trailhead for about 60–100 minutes. The entry time announced by officials for 2026 is 02:00–12:00, verify health certificates, reservations, and latest opening requirements in advance.
从外南梦市区乘专车前往 Benculuk，车程约45–75分钟，由森林景区正式入: Take a private car from downtown Banyuwangi to Benculuk, the drive takes about 45–75 minutes, enter the rain tree avenue on foot from the formal entrance of the forest scenic area.
从宿务市南部汽车站乘经 Barili 的 Bato 方向巴士约3–4小时，到 M: Take a bus heading to Bato via Barili from Cebu City South Bus Terminal for about 3–4 hours, transfer to a tricycle upon arriving in Moalboal town to Panagsama Beach, complete local activity registration and enter the water guided by a guide.
从寺庙群西侧或西南侧开放草坪寻找午后受光立面，不进入限制区域。罗摩衍那演出与景区: Find the afternoon-lit facade from the open lawn on the west or southwest side of the temple complex, without entering restricted areas. Ramayana performances and scenic area tickets are arranged separately. Heritage documentation: https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/642/
从岛内酒店搭电动三轮车前往 Station 1 北部度假村公共海滩入口，或从 D: Take an electric tricycle from island hotels to the public beach entrance of northern resorts at Station 1, or walk north from D'Mall along the coast for about 15–25 minutes.
从岛西部包车约90–120分钟抵达东岸Diamond Beach与Atuh Be: Charter a car from the west of the island for about 90–120 minutes to arrive near the shared scenic area of Diamond Beach and Atuh Beach on the east coast.
从峡谷东南侧俯瞰高度约120米的半环形瀑布，数十束水流沿玄武质岩壁及绿色植被垂落: Overlooking a semi-circular waterfall about 120 meters high from the southeast side of the canyon, dozens of streams of water cascade along basalt rock walls and green vegetation, converging into white water mist in the deep valley, with distant forests enclosing the canyon into a natural giant open-air amphitheater.
从度假村允许通行的栈桥转角使用超广角拍摄木屋纵深，顺光拍摄海底纹理；不要跨越私人: Use an ultra-wide angle to photograph the depth of wooden houses from the turning corner of the boardwalk permitted by the resort, shooting the seabed textures with the sun; do not cross private guest room platforms. Drones must obtain permission from the resort and relevant authorities. Coordinates are resort map location points.
从建筑前方公共广场用广角镜头拍摄完整立面；室内摄影以展厅许可为准。未发现可信证据: Photograph the complete facade using a wide-angle lens from the public square in front of the building; indoor photography is subject to exhibition hall permits. No credible evidence was found indicating that this building was designed by a Pritzker Prize laureate, so no master architect attribution is made.
从开放楼层或水池短边沿中心轴线拍摄水面倒影。地下清真寺等区域可能限制开放，不应以: Photograph water reflections along the central axis from open floors or the short side of the pool. Areas such as underground mosques may restrict access, and non-open spaces should not be taken as mandatory spots to reach.
从开放院落拍摄屋脊细部，使用中长焦提取雕饰；未经许可不近距离拍摄正在祭拜的人群。: Photograph roof details from open courtyards, using medium telephotos to extract carvings; do not photograph people worshiping at close range without permission.
从怡保老城乘网约车约15–25分钟抵达Taman Rapat附近极乐洞入口，沿开: Take a ride-hailing car from Ipoh Old Town for about 15–25 minutes to reach the Kek Lok Tong entrance near Taman Rapat, walk through natural cave chambers along open trails into the rear gardens.
从拉布安巴焦 Labuan Bajo 港口乘快艇约1.5–2.5小时抵达 Pad: Take a speedboat from Labuan Bajo Port for about 1.5–2.5 hours to Padar Selatan, or stay overnight in a nearby legal anchorage in advance via a liveaboard. Reserved mountaineering time slots apply, walk along formal stairs for about 30–50 minutes.
从教堂前庭合法开放区域使用广角拍摄双塔与中央玫瑰窗，再通过获准开放的隧道体验两座: Use wide-angle lenses from the legally open areas of the church forecourt to capture the twin towers and central rose window, then experience the connection of the two religious spaces through the permitted tunnel. Do not assume the tunnel is open all day.
从日惹包车约75–105分钟至马格朗县婆罗浮屠景区，提前购买对应入园及登塔时段门: Charter a car from Yogyakarta for about 75–105 minutes to Borobudur in Magelang Regency, purchase corresponding entry and tower-climbing time slot tickets in advance, tower climbing usually requires joining a designated guided tour according to scenic area requirements.
从日惹向北包车约60–90分钟至Kaliurang周边，再通过获准运营的火山吉普: Charter a car north from Yogyakarta for about 60–90 minutes to around Kaliurang, then reach the open viewing area via volcano jeep tour routes operated with permission.
从日惹王宫南部步行约15–20分钟，或乘当地网约车抵达水宫入口。: Walk south from the Yogyakarta Royal Palace for about 15–20 minutes, or take a local ride-hailing car to the Water Castle entrance.
从普兰巴南景区包车约15–25分钟抵达山顶遗址入口，购买对应开放时段门票。: Charter a car from Prambanan scenic area for about 15–25 minutes to reach the summit ruin entrance, purchase tickets for corresponding open time slots.
从桥两端开放平台使用24mm广角拍完整曲率，不仅局限于桥面自拍。强风、雷电和维护: Use a 24mm wide angle from open platforms at both ends of the bridge to capture the complete curvature, not limited to self-portraits on the deck. Strong winds, lightning, and maintenance may cause closures, operation announcements: https://panoramalangkawi.com/.
从桥的两端沿木质步道向中央取景，使用16–24mm突出波浪结构。夕阳方向受季节变: Walk from both ends of the bridge along wooden walkways toward the center to frame shots, use 16–24mm to highlight the wave structure.
